ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Soil its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Plants its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Energy resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Sounds that alert us and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
